name: Quran in Text and Audio
author: Maidul

sections.description:
Quran in Text and Audio shows the Quran on a WordPress page: the Arabic text with an English translation, and audio for every verse. Put a shortcode in a page or post and visitors can read, listen and follow along. It suits mosque, school and community sites, and personal blogs.

The Arabic text and the English translation (Muhammad Asad) are loaded from the AlQuran.cloud API. Audio is the recitation of Mishary Alafasy (128 kbps) from the Islamic Network audio CDN. Other translations and reciters are not available yet. The plugin has no settings page; everything is controlled by the shortcodes below.

What you get

  • The full Quran with a side list of all 114 surahs, or a single surah.
  • Arabic text with clear ayah numbering, and the English translation under each verse.
  • A play button on every verse in the full Quran and single-surah views, and a sticky audio player at the bottom of the screen that moves on to the next verse.
  • Bookmarks for favourite verses. They are kept in the visitor’s browser only.
  • A single ayah by number, or a random surah or ayah.
  • Responsive layout for phones and tablets.

Shortcodes

Full Quran:

[quran_full]

One surah (replace 1 with a surah number from 1 to 114):

[quran_surah surah=1]

A random surah on each load of an uncached page:

[quran_surah random=true]

One ayah, by its number in the whole Quran (1 to 6236, counted from the first verse of the Quran; it is not a “surah and verse” pair):

[quran_ayah ayah=1]

A random ayah:

[quran_ayah random=true]

The single-ayah shortcode shows the text and the translation. It has no play button or bookmark.

Note: if a page cache is active, a random surah or ayah is chosen when the page is cached and stays the same until the cache is cleared.

External services

This plugin loads its content from two outside services. The calls are made by the visitor’s browser when a page with a Quran shortcode is opened, so these services receive the visitor’s IP address and the usual request headers. The plugin sends no personal data of its own and stores nothing on your server.

AlQuran.cloud API

Provides the Arabic text, the English translation and the list of surahs, from https://api.alquran.cloud/v1. Service: https://alquran.cloud. Terms: https://alquran.cloud/terms-and-conditions.

Islamic Network audio CDN

Provides the verse recitation audio (Mishary Alafasy, 128 kbps) from https://cdn.islamic.network/quran/audio/. Service: https://islamic.network. No separate terms or privacy page was confirmed for this host; see the service’s own site.

Data stored in the visitor’s browser

Bookmarks and recently loaded surahs are saved in the browser’s localStorage. They stay on the visitor’s device.
sections.installation:
INSTALL WITHIN WORDPRESS

  1. Visit the plugins page within your dashboard and select ‘Add New’
  2. Search for “Quran in Text and Audio”
  3. Activate “Quran in Text and Audio” from your Plugins page

INSTALL MANUALLY

  1. Upload quran-in-text-and-audio to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Which translations are included?

One: the English translation by Muhammad Asad. Other languages are not available yet.

Can I change the reciter?

Not yet. Audio is the recitation by Mishary Alafasy at 128 kbps.

Where do the text and audio come from?

The text and translation come from the AlQuran.cloud API (https://alquran.cloud). The audio files come from the Islamic Network CDN (https://cdn.islamic.network). Both are requested by the visitor’s browser, not by your server.

Does the plugin work if those services are down?

No. If the API or the audio host cannot be reached, the text or audio does not load.

How do I show one verse?

Use [quran_ayah ayah=N], where N is the verse number counted from the start of the Quran (1 to 6236). The shortcode does not take a surah and verse pair.

Where are bookmarks saved?

In the visitor’s own browser (localStorage). They are not stored on your site or sent anywhere, and they do not follow the visitor to another device.

Does it add a setting page or a block?

No. It uses shortcodes only.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Compatibility: tested with WordPress 7.1.

1.1.0

  • Security: Fixed attribute escaping in shortcodes (use esc_attr() for data attributes)
  • Security: Added input validation for shortcode parameters (surah: 1-114, ayah: 1-6236)
  • Improved: Better error messaging for invalid shortcode parameters
  • Tested up to: 6.8.2

1.0.9

  • Improved Surah sidebar UI layout with new design
  • Added Arabic Surah names to list
  • Enhanced typography and alignment for better readability
  • Fixed layout issue with long English Surah titles

1.0.8

  • Updated css for ayat

1.0.7

  • Added bookmark feature for individual ayahs with persistent storage in localStorage
  • Improved CSS styling for ayah number and bookmark icons for better visual alignment
  • Applied Arabic font to ayah numbers for consistent typography
  • Cleaned up JavaScript code for improved maintainability and performance
  • Removed inline CSS and moved styles to external stylesheet
  • Enhanced mobile responsiveness and spacing for better user experience

1.0.6

  • Improve Audio play button, its go next one now
  • Added Sticky footer player bar

1.0.5

  • Added quota-safe localStorage caching with TTL for surahs and ayahs
  • Implemented background prefetching of nearby surahs for faster navigation
  • Prefetches initial surahs in idle time after surah list load
  • Falls back gracefully if localStorage quota is exceeded
  • Optimized caching logic to reduce API calls while keeping content fresh
  • Maintained compatibility with existing API endpoints and frontend behavior

1.0.4

  • Improved frontend JS: added fetch retry with timeout and graceful error messages
  • Escaped all dynamic HTML from API for XSS protection
  • Added ARIA labels and keyboard navigation for accessibility
  • Enhanced click handling to support nested elements inside buttons
  • Added loading indicators for ayahs and surahs
  • Maintained backwards compatibility with previous HTML structure

1.0.3

  • Fix surah scroll bug
  • On select surah close sidebar menu

1.0.2

  • Tested upto 6.6.2
  • Conditionally load css

1.0.1

  • Update text domain
  • Conditionally load css
  • Small css color fix
  • Replace native php function with wordpress one

1.0.0

  • Initial Release
